items.entry: Driving sleet falls in a 40-foot-high, 20-foot-radius cylinder centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition 目盲} until initiative count 20 on the next round.

items.name: 旋转风
items.entry: A strong wind blows in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the dragon (see the {@book 城主指南|DMG} for rules on {@book 强风|DMG|5|强风}). The dragon's flying is not affected by this wind, which lasts until the next time the dragon uses a lair action or until the dragon dies.

entries.name: 区域效应
entries: Any of these effects might appear in the area around a white dragon's lair, in addition to or instead of the effects described in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}:

items.name: 刺骨严寒
items.entry: Extreme cold envelops the land within 6 miles of the dragon's lair (see the {@book 城主指南|DMG} for rules on {@book 严寒|DMG|5|严寒}). If the climate in the area already features extreme cold, the cold is numbing, giving creatures in the area without immunity or resistance to cold damage disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks.

items.name: 镜面冰
items.entry: The icy surfaces in the dragon's lair reflect light like mirrors, giving creatures in the lair other than the dragon disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill 隐匿}) checks made to hide. In addition, at each intersection or branching passage, any creature other than the dragon has a 50 percent chance of going in a different direction from the direction it intends.

entries.name: 白龙宝藏
entries: 白龙偏爱那些能反射出冰冷光芒的宝石和贵金属。他们的巢穴地面常常散落着钻石、月光石和石英，以及银币和铂金币，当光线洒在上面时，给人一种星河流淌的印象。尽管白龙仍然重视黄金和铜，但它们通常会将这些金属埋藏在岩石或雪坑中，以防止它们的黄色光泽破坏巢穴的外观。

entries.name: 霜
entries: Rime is a prisoner to her past. This now- {@creature 远古白龙} was raised in captivity, bred as a mount for an ancient knightly order. Mithral plates were magically fused to her skull and breastbone, bearing an enchantment binding her to the service of her rider. And though that rider and their order have been dead for centuries, the magic of the mithral plates still binds Rime to the place of her rider's demise. Only in the winter, when her powers are at their peak, can she range out from the ruined citadel that has become her lair to terrorize surrounding lands.
霜（Rime）的过去经历使她对所有类人生物都持怀疑态度，她经常无缘无故地向他们发泄愤怒。然而，她忍受了那些在她巢穴中定居的邪教徒的存在，因为在她无法狩猎的漫长月份里，他们会给她带来食物。霜也在寻找一种摆脱她的秘银镣铐的方法，并且会谨慎地与可能帮助她的施法者进行对话。如果这失败了，她的计划是继续在她的冬季突袭中积累财宝，直到她有足够的力量完全打破她的束缚。

The greater part of a white dragon's hoard consists of trophies taken from defeated foes. Although these trophies include items such as mighty weapons or ornate regalia that are valuable treasures in their own right, they can just as easily be worthless junk. A white dragon hoards trophies not for their material value, but as testaments to the dragon's dominance. An {@creature 远古白龙||古老的白龙的} lair is a literal memory palace and a maze of rime-encrusted treasures that recount the story of the dragon's many victories.

entries.caption: 白龙艺术物品
rows: 一个雕刻成龙头形状的战号，其大张的嘴巴，龙称之为"小嘟嘟"。
一座描绘精灵圣武士的雕像，面朝上方；龙的爪子已经破坏了雕像的身体
一根巨大的象牙，上面雕刻着描绘一个游牧部落历史的图像；龙使用这根象牙来标记它埋藏金子的地方
一件巨人尺寸的斗篷，上面绣有银色编织图案，龙用它作为其蛋巢的内衬
一个堆满毛皮的木制宝座；任何访客都必须坐在宝座上，而龙则讲述前一位主人的可怕死亡。
一扇巨大的木门，雕刻并绘有手持剑和权杖的君主宝座图；龙偶尔会用指关节敲击门，停顿一下，然后咯咯笑道：'没人在家'
一个霜巨人首领的王冠，带有断裂的角；龙喜欢将这顶王冠放在冰冷的石笋上，然后用尾巴将其击落
一艘船的船头雕刻得像一只扑击的狮子；龙偶尔会对着狮子吼叫。
一面镀金的盾牌，上面刻有被遗忘之神的圣徽；龙喜欢用爪子轻弹盾牌，聆听它发出的声音
一个矮人制造的仪式铁砧；凝视着铁砧，龙深情地回忆道："一击七杀！"
一幅长长的绣花亚麻挂毯，展示了一个古老王国内战的历史；当龙睡眠不佳时，它会'阅读'这幅挂毯。
一个雕刻着天使群像的铃铛，仍然挂在其破碎的钟楼上；龙用尾巴敲响铃铛，每次响声中都咆哮着它击败的敌人之一的名字

data.name: 怪物图鉴
entries: Across the worlds of the Material Plane and beyond, draconic creatures appear in myriad varieties. This chapter introduces the family of gem dragons, cousins to the chromatic and metallic dragons presented in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}. It also includes additional creatures of the Dragon type and creatures often associated with dragons or found in their lairs.
These monsters are arranged in alphabetical order. For guidance on how to use a creature's stat block, consult the {@book 简介|MM|0} of the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}.

images.title: 封面上：神奇的费兹班保护着一群无辜者，水晶龙和红龙在空中交战，这是克里斯·拉恩的画作。
在封面上：来自费兹班故事中的水晶和红龙栩栩如生，揭示了这幅由阿纳托·芬斯塔克绘制的画作中宇宙的内在冲突。
